
import torch

class Model(torch.nn.Module):
    def __init__(self, splitSizes=[2], dim=0):
        super().__init__()
        self.splitSizes = splitSizes
        self.dim = dim

    def forward(self, x1):
        splits = [x] # 1
        # The following line is generated by the "Optimize split-withsizes" pass and should be ignored by the user. It may or not exist depending on their model's particularities.

        return torch.split(splits[0], splitSizes=self.splitSizes, dim=dim)[0]

# Initializing the model
splitSizes = [2]
m  = Model(splitSizes)

 # Inputs to the model
x1  = torch.randn(4,)
